notes.title: Update 4.01
notes.notes:
So, a new update numbered 4.01 is being released today.

The list of changes, fixes and additions is below:

[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug where when selecting "Random" weather - it would often snow.
[*] Added some new characters to the train station
[*] Removed some trees that were causing the game to slow down while traveling by train
[*] Fixed a bug where a player could fall out of the train when moving to another car.
[*] Fixed a bug where some doors in cars would not open.
[*] Added new objects on the train track.
[/olist].

We also announce the development of a new train game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2757610/TransSiberian_Express/]Trans-Siberian Express[/url].

notes.title: Update, version 2.3
notes.notes:
So, released update 2.3.

First of all, great optimization of the game has been done, bugs have been fixed. Improved shadows and global lighting. The picture has become more soft and beautiful.

notes.title: Russian Train Trip 2 Trailer
notes.notes:
Today released the trailer of the upcoming game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2190470/Russian_Train_Trip_2/]Russian Train Trip 2[/url].

The game very soon (in March) will appear as an alpha version at a discounted price. We recommend you to add it to your wishlist, if you haven't done it already.

notes.title: Update 2.0 is out
notes.notes:
Greetings to all train travel lovers!
Finally, we are releasing a major game update 2.0.

Added:

[list]
[*] The ability to get out of the car (to the station or just jump out into the street)
[*] Food cravings (can be reduced by selecting a difficulty level)
[*] Buying and selling goods (souvenirs / food)
[*] Ryazan-1 railway station
[*] New player movement system (added a jump to enter the carriage)
[*] Dynamic weather system (appearance of rain, fog, sun, etc.)
[*] Dynamic change of day and night (time is accelerated)
[*] Transition between all cars
[*] New companions, bags, items have been added to the wagon
[*] New extensive menu
[*] and much more...
[/list]

ATTENTION! The game may contain bugs and errors. We would be grateful for any feedback, let's improve the game together!

Thank you for your attention and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Latest development news
notes.notes:
Greetings friends!

We are working on the game every day, we have done a lot of things, now we are looking for and fixing errors, we are polishing.

What we did:
[list]
[*] Exiting the train, you can get off anywhere and board any train.
[*] Hunger system. You need to monitor this indicator, buy food, water at the stations, ask the guide to eat.
[*] Inventory. You can buy various items from merchants or, for example, from a vending machine.
[*] There are many trains of different routes, the timetable for the arrival of each train is posted.
[*] One railway station Ryazan.
[*] Changed completely player control, you can jump, the camera swings when moving, etc.
[/list]

There are plans to add another station, expand the route, diversify it, introduce achievements (achievements) and much more. Stay tuned and don't miss the update, coming soon!

notes.title: Added exit at stations
notes.notes:
Greetings to all travelers!

We have been working on the possibility of getting out of the car for a long time, since we did not initially plan to do this during development, and we completely changed the entire source code of the game so that you enjoy the opportunity to get out and enter the car whenever you want.

Now we are bringing everything to mind and fixing bugs, we will show the result soon, stay tuned!

notes.title: The game went on sale
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear friends!

Our game was released in the early alpha version. We decided to release the game now to read your feedback, wishes and criticism, in order to improve the game in the future and understand what users need in the end. Please be understanding.

notes.title: Improved game graphics
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear railway lovers!

All this time, we focused our efforts on building the route, game mechanics, and left the graphic component to the background. So, the last few days we have been tweaking and improving the graphics. At the moment we can show you how things are and if you have any wishes regarding graphics, we will be glad to see your comments.

notes.title: What's new added to the game in 2 weeks
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear friends!

We did a lot of work in 2 weeks, and here's what we added:

[list]
[*] Selecting weather and time of day in the main menu when starting the game
[*] Dialogues between passengers (and conversations are different depending on the time of day)
[*] You can lie on any unoccupied upper seat
[*] Fully built route
[/list]

Yes, this is not a lot, but we are trying, there is still a lot of work and I want to release the game as fully as possible.

And below you can watch a small teaser of what awaits you in the game :)

[previewyoutube=w7i5Q8MlyPs;full][/previewyoutube]
